content.text: Survey the biomedical literature on CRISPR gene editing to restore immune cell function in aged organisms and keep a durable project record of it all: the lead hypothesis with the search evidence behind it, the method you would test it with, what the searches showed, the decisions you took, and your confidence in the lead hypothesis, with the supporting evidence linked to the hypothesis it backs.

arguments.command: python3 __REPO__/skills/theta-lit-search/scripts/pubmed.py --query "CRISPR gene therapy" --json | python3 __REPO__/skills/theta-notebook/scripts/notebook.py --hypothesis "CRISPR-based gene editing can restore immune cell function in aged organisms" --evidence - --grade asserted
